title: lead-team-strategy-capture-2026-09-03
content:
Cross-team leadership weekly notes — 2026-09-03
Owners: Aisha Kumar (note lead) + rotating minute taker
Attendees: Aisha, Marcus, Sofia, Diego, Claire, Ravi (brief), Emma (SRE), Tasha (product)

Purpose: quick alignment on urgent cross-cutting risks, launches, capacity forecasts, and outstanding decisions. Keep this intentionally terse — record decisions and clear next actions.

1) Quick readouts (3 mins each)
- Serving Runtime (Marcus)
  - v0.9.3 kernel rollout ongoing in eu-west-1 canaries — CPU utilization down ~11% on p3x instances for standard-token workloads. P95 latency stable, small p50 improvement.
  - Known issue: one shard showing KV-cache eviction thrash under 2048-seq workloads (tracking ENG-4123). Temporary mitigation: reduce max-batch-size on affected pool; long fix in progress.

- Platform / Deploy (Sofia)
  - Dedicated cluster autoscale test passed for warm-up scenario — still seeing 2–3 minute cold-starts for new workers; target is <90s. Root cause appears to be container image pull and init scripts.
  - Private deployment pilot (customer: FinLaw) scheduled to start next Tuesday; preflight checklist mostly green — encryption cert rotation step still manual.

- Solutions / Customer Escalations (Diego)
  - Two smallish customer escalations this week: one performance regression on a custom quantized model (investigating quant-decoding path), one request about vector-embedding drift after a model swap. Both flagged as high priority for next 48h.

- SRE / Observability (Emma)
  - Alert noise reduced after rule tuning — but a regression alert fired during a Canary test (false positive on token-drop). Need to refine synthetic hit patterns.
  - Incident post-mortem draft for the 08/24 outage in progress; will circulate for review by Friday.

2) Decisions made (recorded)
- Temporarily lower default max-batch-size on shared inference pools until ENG-4123 patch is validated in canaries. (Decision owner: Marcus, effective immediately)
- Proceed with FinLaw private-pilot next Tuesday with manual cert rotation but under supervised runbook; get support from security on-call during first 48h. (Owner: Sofia + Claire)
- Approve additional 0.5 FTE of SRE time (contractor) for September to accelerate alert refinement and incident backlog. (Owner: Ravi, finance approval in flight)

3) Action items (clear owners + due dates)
- Marcus: finish ENG-4123 patch and post canary results by 2026-09-06. If canaries show >5% p95 regression, rollback plan must be ready.
- Sofia & Claire: automate cert rotation step for private-deploy by 2026-09-10; until then, produce a one-page runbook and runbook dry-run by 2026-09-07.
- Diego: owner for customer-quant issue — create a reproducible test-case and open PR to try decode-path guardrails by 2026-09-08.
- Emma: finalize outage post-mortem and share with execs by 2026-09-04. Add concrete mitigations and owners for each corrective action.
- Aisha: schedule a 30m cross-team sync specifically to align on rollout guardrails for kernel/quantization changes (proposed 2026-09-09).

4) Open blockers / risks (heatmap style)
- High: KV-cache eviction thrash (serving runtime) — potential to cause tail-latency spikes under production seq distribution. Mitigation: temporary batch-size reduction + patch in flight.
- High: cert rotation manual step for private deployments — risk to pilot schedule and compliance posture. Mitigation: runbook + security on-call during pilot; automation target next week.
- Medium: Dedicated cluster cold-start > target (2–3 min vs 90s) — impacts bursty enterprise workloads. Mitigation: pre-warm strategy and optimize image layers.
- Low: alert synthetic false positives — noisy but mitigations in place.

5) Metrics snapshot (quick numbers called out)
- Platform throughput (hosted): avg tokens/s +3% w/w — driven by customer X ramp.
- P95 latency (global): 430ms (steady). Canary p95 for kernel v0.9.3: 410ms (small improvement).
- Error budget burn (monthly): 6% consumed (target <10%).
- Cost anomaly: one AWS bill spike in us-west-2 due to unexpected scaling for a partner test (investigating, billing ticket opened).

6) Cross-team asks / FYI
- Product: feature gating plan for function-calling needs to be clearer for Solutions — Diego to get a short doc in product backlog.
- Security: Claire notes we need to add KMS key rotation testing into the private-deploy preflight checklist.
- Hiring: Headcount ask for two infra SRE hires is queued — update to leadership planned next Tuesday.

7) Parking lot (next meetings)
- Deep dive requested: model-quantization rollout guardrails (30–40m) — include runtime, models, solutions, and product. Target 2026-09-09.
- Capacity planning for Q4 — start prep week of 2026-09-14 (include Dedicated sales forecasts).
- Post-mortem review for 08/24 outage — review with execs 2026-09-10.

Notes-to-self / rough thoughts:
- Consider a short-lived "canary-policy" flag that isolates experimental kernels to a subset of customers with SLA exemptions; reduces blast radius for perf regressions.
- Track customer pilot metrics separately in the console (private pilot namespace) to avoid confusing hosted aggregates.

Meeting end: 11:30am PT. Next regular sync: 2026-09-10 (weekly cadence).

Attachments / links in thread: add canary graphs, ENG-4123 draft patch link, runbook stub (Sofia) — to be attached to confluence page after meeting.
